text.p: Universal Electronics Inc said on Tuesday that it expects net income for 1996 to be the range of $0.25 to $0.35 per share.
This is below analysts' expectations of $0.65 per share, the company said.
It said it earned $0.05 per share in 1995.

The company cited disappointing results at its cable business, and said that while the introduction of two key new products has been well received, orders for these have been far from what was expected.
It said it believed this was an issue of timing and not positioning, and was not a permanent situation.

The company also said it believes its Japanese OEM business will fall short of expectations this year due to price squeezes, and added that it plans to step up its efforts in this area by adding several new sales executives.

For the first six months of 1996, the company reported net sales of $43.4 million compared with $43.2 million for the same period last year. Net loss for the first half of 1996 was $322,000, or $0.05 per share, compared with a net loss of $2.4 million, or $0.36 for the first half of 1995.
